why: scripts/debate-drill-bank-baseline.json is the CONTENT FREEZE for the Debate drill bank: a checked-in copy of accepted educational fields, so an item edit has to be a deliberate two-file diff a reviewer can read.
It covers 150 items. The bank now holds 187: the signposting area (30) and the constructive-speech area (7) were authored after the freeze was taken and were never added to it.

Those 37 items are NOT frozen here either. Their bytes are deliberately not snapshotted: existing is not the same as reviewed, and snapshotting them would convert 'never reviewed' into 'accepted baseline' without earning it.

What this record buys is COVERAGE ACCOUNTING, not content protection. Every bank id is now either frozen or listed here, so a new uncovered id cannot appear silently — and the freeze still cannot detect a content mutation in any id listed below.
migration: An id leaves this list only by earning the freeze: the item is independently reviewed, its accepted bytes are added to scripts/debate-drill-bank-baseline.json, and the id is removed from here in the same commit.
There is no automatic promotion, and no prefix rule: adding an area does not add its items to either set.
limits: Signposting: the LESSON was audited and checkpointed (2026-09-06). That is not a review of these 30 drill items. Two of them (sp-16, sp-24) were adjudicated untaught and are held; the other 28 have had their rationales re-anchored but not a full content review.
Constructive speech: no perfection audit has happened at all. Nothing about these 7 items is reviewed.
